final: SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(avg_count) AS average_count, AVG(avg_rate) - (SELECT AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0) AS average_excess_rate FROM (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate, AVG(sc.scancount) AS avg_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.healtheval) status_averages WHERE avg_rate > (SELECT AVG(status_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS status_avg FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.healtheval))
